tools.name: check_amfion_fit
tools.description: Checks Amfion's capabilities, pricing and suitability for a business type and stated needs. Returns matching capabilities as "yes", "partly" with conditions, or "no", along with supported business types, limitations, plans, prices and links. Covers Amfion's product capabilities rather than facts about a specific business.

business_type.description: The kind of business in the person's words, for example "mobile dog grooming" or "plumbing and HVAC".

needs.description: What the person wants it to do, in their words, for example "answer calls after hours, book jobs, put them in Jobber".

tools.name: build_front_desk_preview
tools.description: Builds a temporary front desk preview from a service business's public website, including services, prices, hours and policies. Returns a preview handle, current build status and links immediately; completion typically takes about a minute. Creates no account and publishes nothing. Amfion is not intended for practices handling health information.

website.description: The business's own website address, for example harborpawsgrooming.com.

tools.name: get_front_desk_preview
tools.description: Retrieves a front desk preview using its handle or URL. Returns the current build step while processing. A ready preview includes services, prices and appointment lengths with source or assumption labels, hours, cases requiring a person, missing information, suggested test questions, remaining test budget and links.

preview.description: The preview handle or preview URL.

tools.name: ask_front_desk_preview
tools.description: Sends one simulated customer message to a ready preview and returns its reply, actions and remaining test budget. An optional conversation identifier continues an existing test conversation. Bookings are test bookings; no customer is contacted and no email is sent. Each preview has conversation and message limits.

preview.description: The `preview` handle or the preview link.

message.description: What a customer would write, for example "How much is a full groom for a large doodle, and can you fit me in Saturday?"

conversation.description: An optional conversation identifier from an earlier call. When absent, a new test conversation starts.

tools.name: get_website_install
tools.description: Returns website installation code for an existing live Amfion business identified by its Amfion address, connected domain or short name. Includes chat-bubble, in-page-chat and request-form snippets, Content-Security-Policy entries, placement notes and verification steps. Unclaimed previews are unsupported. Makes no changes.

business.description: The business's Amfion address (harbor-paws.amfionhq.com), connected domain, or short name (harbor-paws).
